content.rendered:
Melbourne Bulldog Clinic is a specialist division of Southern Animal Health, with a particular focus on brachycephalic breeds — French bulldogs, English bulldogs, pugs, Boston terriers and similar flat-faced breeds.

Our experienced veterinary team offers BOAS (Brachycephalic Obstructive Airway Syndrome) assessments and surgical correction, orthopaedic procedures, and the full range of general veterinary services. We are committed to giving bulldogs and flat-faced breeds the specialised care they need to live healthy, comfortable lives.

For more information, visit our dedicated site at melbournebulldogclinic.com.au.

We know that your pets are special members of your family and that you want them to live long, healthy and happy lives. We know how much you worry when they are sick and that you will stay up all night with them if need be. The vets and nurses at Foothills Animal Hospital understand this and are here to help.

  • See the same, experienced vets every time
  • Award-winning, accredited, family friendly hospital
  • Gentle, affordable and complete professional care

By being part of the Foothills Animal Hospital, you will be supporting a family business that also gives back to the local community, schools, animal rescue shelters and sporting clubs.

Welcome to our Foothills family.

At Southpaws, we pride ourselves on a company culture centred around our core values and mission: to provide exceptional care to our animal patients and their families.

We believe in a collaborative, team-based approach to veterinary care, where every team member plays an essential role in delivering exceptional care to our patients. We are committed to treating every patient with compassion and respect. We believe in open and transparent communication with our clients, ensuring they are informed and involved in their pet’s care at every step.

Our team members are dedicated to ongoing learning and development, and we encourage and support continuing education opportunities, both internal and external training programs. We believe in promoting from within, offering opportunities for career advancement, and valuing a healthy work-life balance to support our team members.
